title: Five cells over a full bag
about: Farm, day 9 at 10:00, every hotbar slot filled (seeds, a sprinkler, a scarecrow) and more in the bag. The five cells show the tool cell (hoe, scythe, rod, pickaxe: tap it again for the next), the can and the three item slots; the rest of the bag is one tap on Menu or a flick on Action (the ring) away. Scroll with the Action swipe and press Action at once: the highlighted cell is what is used.
